description: All the channels of one polyphonic signal reduced to six single figures, in 2HP, either afresh each cycle or tracked since a reset

params.text: Chooses when the running figures are cleared: dark clears them every cycle, red clears them only on a reset
Chooses what the outputs carry: one channel each, or one channel per input channel tracking that channel on its own

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are measured
A rising edge clears the running figures so they build again from what arrives next

outputs.text: Carries the lowest value found among the channels
Carries the highest value found among the channels
Carries whichever value found is closest to 0V, positive or negative
Carries whichever value found is furthest from 0V, positive or negative
Carries the average of the channel values
Carries the distance between the highest and the lowest value, or their total when the menu is set to Sum

notes: polyphonic output mode is worth using only with the reset mode set to clear on a trigger, since otherwise each channel is measured against itself alone in one cycle
menu: Range/Sum output mode: Range (max-min, default), Sum — chooses what the last output carries
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed

inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
